Building Russian industrial infrastructure since 2004

Northgate Industrial JSC is a full-cycle general contractor: design, steel frame, envelope, building services and turnkey handover. Our own steel fabrication plant in Vorsino, four regional divisions, 1,240 people on staff.

380+

projects delivered

1.2m m²

built since 2004

1,240

people on staff

22 years

in the market

What we do

We take the whole facility — from site investigation to final acceptance. The client gets one contract, one schedule and one accountable party. Owning our steel fabrication means we do not depend on third-party supply and can hold the date even when the design changes mid-build.

BIM design in-house

Structural and MEP departments on staff. LOD 350 model, shop drawings issued from the same model.

Our own plant

Vorsino, Kaluga Region. 18,000 t of steel structures a year, shot blasting and coating on the line.

Self-performed erection

Nine erection crews, 46 owned machines. Subcontractors only for specialist works.

Handover and support

As-built documentation, commissioning, 5-year structural and 3-year services warranty.

History

2004
Founded
An erection unit of 14 people, first projects were warehouses near Moscow.
2009
First 10,000 m² facility
Logistics complex in Domodedovo, start of work with national retailers.
2014
Vorsino plant
Own steel fabrication launched, ending dependence on outside suppliers.
2019
Regional expansion
Divisions in Yekaterinburg, Kazan and Novosibirsk. First projects beyond the Urals.
2023
Heavy industry
Production buildings for machinery and pharma, facilities in special economic zones.
2026
Today
11 projects running in parallel, the 2027 order book is 74% committed.

Where we work

Head office and plant sit in the Vorsino industrial park. Regional divisions: Yekaterinburg, Kazan, Novosibirsk, Rostov-on-Don. We work across European Russia, the Urals and Western Siberia.
